'''2024 Jawa Cup''' was the Players Committee Jawa Format event on GEMP, 13–25 February 2024. [[Conor Britain]] won, defeating [[Jason Riendeau]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-03-jawa-cup-top-8-feb-13-25-on-gemp/. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022025044/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2024-03-jawa-cup-top-8-feb-13-25-on-gemp.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/conor-britain-captures-the-third-biennial-jawa-cup-crown/ Conor Britain Captures the Third Biennial Jawa Cup Crown], starwarsccg.org (8 March 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022203120/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/conor-britain-captures-the-third-biennial-jawa-cup-crown.html Internet Archive]</ref>
